newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Reid Farmers says outlook better.
newsitem.headline: Reid Farmers says outlook better.

text.p: Reid Farmers Ltd said on Monday it expected some price recovery and an increase in production within the wool industry in the coming year.
The company earlier reported a net profit for the year to June 30 of NZ$3.32 million, against $3.78 million the previous year.
It reported at the half year that lower returns to farmers had resulted in a major uplift in farmers debt and this trend was the biggest challenge facing many farmers.

"We still believe this to be correct and this trend will need to be prudently and carefully managed to include tight budget controls. With these controls and a better price forecast for prime lamb and an increase in wool production we look forward with the farmers to a better outlook," the company said in a statement.
